scripts.start: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(!fs.existsSync('./web/dist')) { console.log('🚀 Dist missing, building...'); require('child_process').execSync('npm run build', {stdio:'inherit'}); }" && node backend/server.js
scripts.build: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix web --include=dev --legacy-peer-deps && npm run build --prefix web
